title: Finite local generators in degree zero for the ideal-power Rees action
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, f:X→Spec A a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], I⊂A an ideal, J=I O_X [def-nagata-extended-ideal], and F a quasi-coherent O_X-module of finite type [pqf-def-coherent]. Write G_m=J^m F with its image inclusion j_m [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], and B_k=I^k t^k [def-nagata-rees-algebra], [def-nagata-rees-piece]. Suppose maps μ_(m,k)(b):G_m→G_(m+k) satisfy j_(m+k)(μ_(m,k)(b)(s))=f^sharp(coeff_k(b)) j_m(s) on every open. Then each x∈X has an open U containing x and finitely many sections s_i∈G_0(U) such that, for every m, V⊂U, t∈G_m(V), and y∈V, some neighbourhood W⊂V of y has t|_W in the O_X(W)-span of μ_(0,m)(b)(s_i|_W), b∈B_m. The empty family is allowed. In particular all generating degrees are zero.

proof.text: The private isFiniteType_over helper restricts finite local generating data along Over.forget U. Choose an affine neighbourhood U of x and apply quasicoherent_finite_type_affine and Module.Finite.exists_fin to obtain u_i spanning F(U). The degree-zero product inclusion j_0 is the image inclusion of the identity whiskered with F followed by the left unitor; the multiplication is an isomorphism, so its image inclusion is epi and mono, hence iso. Lift u_i by the inverse of j_0 to s_i.
Apply idealPowersLocalCoefficientSpan to u_i and t in G_m(V) at y. It supplies W on which j_m(t restricted to W) belongs to the scalar span of f-sharp(a) times the restricted u_i, for a in I^m.

For each coefficient a in I^m, reesMonomial I a lies in the degree-m piece. Use the assumed multiplication formula at (0,m) and naturality of j_0 to identify its action on the restricted lift s_i with f-sharp(a) times the restricted u_i after applying j_m. The proved app_cast and inclusion_cast helpers transport across 0+m=m, preserving the original HEq conclusion. Every coefficient generator therefore lies in the image under j_m of the desired span. Submodule.span_le gives the same membership for j_m(t). The image inclusion j_m is mono, so its section map is injective; pull the membership back to the original section t.

theorem idealPowersReesZeroGenerators {A : Type v} [CommRing A]
    {X : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
    (I : Ideal A) (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hJ : J = (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f)
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFiniteType] :
    let G := fun m ↦ Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι m).2 F
    let graded := reesGrading I
    ∀ (mu : ∀ (m k : ℕ), graded k → (G m ⟶ G (m + k))),
      (∀ (m k : ℕ) (b : graded k) (U : X.Opens) (s : (G m).val.obj (op U)),
        ((Scheme.idealModuleProductι (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι (m + k)).2 F).app
          U).hom ((mu m k b).app U s) =
        (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv ≫ f.appLE ⊤ U le_top).hom
          (b.val.val.coeff k)) •
        ((Scheme.idealModuleProductι (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι m).2 F).app
          U).hom s) →
      (∀ x : X, ∃ (U : X.Opens), x ∈ U ∧
      ∃ (r : ℕ) (s : Fin r → (G 0).val.obj (op U)),
        ∀ (m : ℕ) (V : X.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ U) (t : (G m).val.obj (op V))
          (y : X), y ∈ V → ∃ (W : X.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ V), y ∈ W ∧
            (G m).val.map (homOfLE hWV).op t ∈
              Submodule.span ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op W))
                {z | ∃ (i : Fin r), 0 ≤ m ∧
                  ∃ b : graded (m - 0),
                    HEq z ((mu (0) (m - 0) b).val.app (op W)
                      ((G (0)).val.map (homOfLE (hWV.trans hVU)).op (s i)))})
